body:
## Build a Reliable Request

A request works in a test console but fails in the app because its headers, model name, or message shape differ.

Follow the API contract for authentication, endpoint, fields, and response parsing. Set timeouts and handle rate-limit and server errors separately.

Retry only safe failures with delay and randomness. Record request IDs so provider support and your logs can trace one call.
common_mistakes: API keys are safest inside public browser code.
Every failed request should retry forever.
mini_exercise: Draw “Build a Reliable Request” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: AI APIs let products use managed models while keeping credentials, errors, and costs under application control.
